display.purpose: The amount on the entry tag, sized by the tag container; steps down as the number grows.

headline.purpose: The total on the Přehled tag.

price.purpose: Amounts in category rows (1.375rem), the day list (1.25rem), the entry editor (1.5rem) and payments still to come (1.125rem, muted).

title.purpose: The period range and view names in the top rail.

name.purpose: Category names in capitals on shelf labels and category rows; recurring payment and editable category names in sentence case.

label.purpose: Buttons and the undo strip actions; VRÁTIT, section heads, tabs, the date chip, form labels and the PRAVIDELNÁ chip use close variants.

list.purpose: Entry categories and picker options; text being written and the shelf hint at the same width.

body.purpose: Help copy and messages, up to 60ch.

caption.purpose: Running totals, counts, section-head notes and picker notes, in muted.

shadows.name: hang-hole
shadows.purpose: The only soft shadow: depth for the 16px punched hole in each tag, filled with the ground colour.

shadows.name: drawn-ring
shadows.purpose: The 2px outline on quiet buttons and the undo strip Poznámka action, drawn inside so they keep their size.

shadows.name: chip-ring
shadows.purpose: Outline of the PRAVIDELNÁ chip on entries a recurring payment wrote.

shadows.name: archived-ring
shadows.purpose: Outline for archived category rows in Nastavení, whose fill drops to transparent.

motion.name: ease-print
motion.purpose: The one curve: fast start, weighted landing. Used by every animation and transition.

motion.name: print-down
motion.purpose: On save the tag amount drops 22px out while fading, then the fresh zero prints in from 14px above.

motion.name: stamp
motion.purpose: The tapped shelf label lands 3px low in yellow with ink lettering and settles back as the yellow fades.

motion.name: print-down-strip
motion.purpose: The undo strip feeds down from under the top rail, clipped from the top and dropping 12px.

motion.name: nudge
motion.purpose: The one sideways move: the tag shakes (-6px, +4px) when a label is tapped with no amount.

motion.name: countdown-fill
motion.purpose: The yellow countdown strip in the top rail grows left to right as the period runs.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Under prefers-reduced-motion every animation and transition collapses to 1ms.

canonical.name: Cenovka
canonical.tokens: frontmatter colors, with -dark siblings for dark mode

schemes.selection: data-theme on <html>, set before first paint from settings.theme; an unknown id falls back to cenovka; meta theme-color follows --rail; the home-screen icon stays Cenovka yellow.

roles.purpose: A light, clear colour the ink reads on: the price tag and everything you act on. The same in light and dark.
A deep ink in the tag hue and its solid mixes over the tag (secondary text, the dotted note line and rule, the empty zero). The same in light and dark.

A deep colour for both rails and the keypad seams; in light mode it also draws the shelf rules, the focus ring and, in every scheme but Cukrová vata, the bar. In dark mode the rail goes near-black, rules take the text colour, and the focus ring and bar take the tag colour.
A ground tinted towards the scheme, near-white labels and keys, and the text that sits on them; tinted near-blacks in dark mode.
The line through a cancelled amount: always a red, lifted in dark mode.

components.name: Scheme Picker
components.description: Nastavení → Vzhled: every scheme as a small preview of the app drawn in its own tokens (rail bar, tag with 129 Kč and hang hole, three mini labels), picked like a radio; the chosen card gets a 3px rule ring and "· vybráno".

narrative.overview:
Cenovka is the Czech supermarket shelf price tag. Each spend is a tag printed in three taps; the pay period is the shelf it lands on. In the canonical Cenovka scheme the tag is shop yellow and black shelf-edge rails frame the top and bottom of every view. Between them, a grey ground holds square white labels, each hung from a heavy black top rule, and the tags are the only large block of colour on screen. It reads like a shop's own signage, printed and matter-of-fact, not like a finance product. Five colourways recolour the same shelf through the same tokens.

Density is shelf-like: one narrow column, controls packed 2 to 12px apart, every touch target at least 44px. Hierarchy comes from one condensed grotesque, Archivo, ranked by how narrow it runs, how heavy and how big: prices in the narrowest, heaviest cut, names and actions in condensed capitals, sentences at normal width. Colour does almost no ranking. The tag colour means tag or action, ink means numerals and rules, strike red means cancelled.

The world refuses the fintech dashboard: no rounded, shadowed white cards, no donut chart, no gradient header, no floating plus. Motion prints, short, weighted and downward. Nothing floats.
keyCharacteristics: One tag-coloured tag owns each view; everything else is white label, ground or rail.
Heavy 3px top rules and square corners; only tags (6px) and standalone controls (4px) are rounded.
Solid rules hold what is written; dashed rules hold what isn't live.
One variable family ranked by width (62, 75, 87.5 and 100%), weight and size.
Flat throughout: depth comes from fill, rule and seam, never shadow.
Every state carries a form and a word, never colour alone.
Motion prints downward on one weighted curve.
Six colour schemes on the same 21 tokens, light and dark; the tag and its ink never change between modes.

rules.name: The Tag Colour Rule
rules.body: The tag colour is the tag and what you act on: price tags, primary actions, the undo action, Hotovo, the chosen option, the active tab bar, the countdown fill, the stamp flash, and the focus ring on the rails. It never fills the ground, a section or a plain label.

rules.name: The Strike Rule
rules.body: Strike red only crosses out: it strikes cancelled amounts and does nothing else. Errors are written in ink, and actions that replace or delete data use the ink button.

rules.name: The Tag Doesn't Dim Rule
rules.body: The tag and its ink family are the same in light and dark, in every scheme. Dark mode swaps the ground, labels, keys, rules and rails around the tags; the tags print exactly the same.

rules.name: The Colourway Rule
rules.body: A scheme recolours tokens and nothing else. Components take every colour role from a token, never a hex, so a screen designed in Cenovka holds in every colourway, light and dark.

rules.name: The Width Is Rank Rule
rules.body: Rank by width before anything else: 62% for prices, 75% for names, labels, rails, keys and buttons, 87.5% for list lines, hints and text being written, normal width for sentences. Weight follows role: 800 for prices, names and actions, 700 for keys, tabs and list lines, 600 for meta, hints and written notes, 400 for prose.

rules.name: The Small Haléře Rule
rules.body: Every amount prints like a shelf price: crowns big, haléře small and raised (0.46em on the tag, 0.62em lifted 0.42em inline), "Kč" smaller after the number, tabular figures, never wrapping.

rules.name: The Shelf Rail Rule
rules.body: Every view hangs between two rails in the rail colour. The top rail carries what you are looking at (the period with its countdown or status, or the view name); the bottom rail carries the three tabs. Content scrolls between them, never over them.

rules.name: The Printed Flat Rule
rules.body: Nothing floats. To make something stand out, give it a fill, a rule or a word, never a shadow.

rules.name: The Shelf Edge Rule
rules.body: Every white label, row, field and panel hangs from a 3px top rule in `rule` and keeps square corners.

rules.name: The Dashed Line Rule
rules.body: A dashed rule means not live: an archived category, or a payment not written yet. Everything written sits on a solid rule.

rules.name: The Write-Here Rule
rules.body: A dotted underline means you can write here: 2px under a field, 1px under the invitation to add a note. While you write, the line goes solid instead of showing a focus outline.

rules.name: The Form and Word Rule
rules.body:
Every state carries a form and a word, never colour alone:
- The active tab gets a top bar.
- The chosen option gets a chevron.
- A deleted entry gets a strike, SMAZÁNO and VRÁTIT.
- An archived category gets a dashed rule and "vyřazená".
- An empty category reads "nic".
- An entry without a note reads "přidat poznámku" over a dotted line.
- A payment still to come sits on a dashed rule under "Ještě přijde"; one already written carries PRAVIDELNÁ.
- The chosen scheme gets a 3px ring and "· vybráno".
- The no-amount warning is heavier and darker, and changes its words.

rules.name: The Printing Motion Rule
rules.body:
Motion prints: short, weighted and downward on `cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.9, 0.3, 1)`, from 260 to 500ms.
- The amount drops out and a fresh one prints in.
- A label stamps down.
- The undo strip feeds down from under the rail. The only sideways move is the refusal nudge. Reduced motion collapses every animation to 1ms.

dos: Do print every amount in Archivo at 62% width and 800 weight with tabular figures, small raised haléře and a smaller "Kč" after the number.
Do hang every white label, row, field and panel from a 3px top rule in `rule`, with square corners; round only tags (6px) and standalone controls (4px).
Do keep the tag colour for tags and for what you act on: primary buttons, undo, Hotovo, the chosen option, the active tab bar.
Do use the ink button (rail fill, lettering in the tag colour) for actions that replace or delete data.
Do write field errors in text ink at 700, directly under the field.
Do mark writable text with a dotted underline that goes solid while you write, with its placeholder in muted (soft ink on the tag).
Do draw anything not written yet on a dashed rule, with its amount in muted.
Do give every state a form and a word, not just a colour.
Do take every colour from a token, and check a new screen in more than one scheme, in light and dark.
Do keep touch targets at least 44px (shelf labels 58px, tabs 52px) and the column no wider than 520px.
Do move things down when they print or are pressed, on `cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.9, 0.3, 1)`, and collapse motion to 1ms under reduced motion.
donts: Don't use strike red for anything but the line through a cancelled amount: not for fills, buttons, errors or destructive actions.
Don't build the fintech dashboard: no rounded, shadowed white cards, no donut or pie chart, no gradient header, no floating plus button.
Don't add drop shadows or elevation; the hang hole's inset is the only soft shadow.
Don't introduce a second typeface; rank with Archivo's width, weight and size.
Don't signal a state with colour alone.
Don't make anything float, bounce or rise; the only sideways move is the refusal nudge.
Don't put small uppercase lead-ins above headings. Condensed capitals name the thing itself: a label, a section head, an action or a tag's name line.
Don't dim or invert the tags in dark mode.
Don't hard-code a colour, or add a scheme that leaves out a token or misses a floor in the contrast contract.
